svg.aria-label: The stack in five strata — interfaces (flutter, nuxt web and webapp), api (laravel with octane, sanctum, pennant, horizon, reverb, pest), data (aurora, elasticache, s3), cloud (aws, cloudflare), ship (docker swarm, ghcr, actions, app stores, loki, grafana, discord) — worlds arise from the cloud substrate upward

g.text: laravel — octane (swoole) · sanctum · pennant · horizon · reverb · pest
aurora — postgres locally · aws in prod
elasticache — redis locally · aws in prod
s3 — minio locally · aws in prod
the remote half of the stack
ec2 swarm host · s3 buckets · iam — minted idempotently
